public.title: Observable
public.description: input {source,subscriptions}; source is a finite event list next {value}, error {value}, or complete, and ends at its first terminal event. Each subscription {id,limit} starts a fresh cold execution from the first source event; limit caps delivered next events and automatically unsubscribes as soon as reached. A limit of 0 emits nothing. Emit [id,"next",value], [id,"error",value] or [id,"complete"] in subscription order then source order. Terminal events stop that subscription and are omitted after automatic unsubscribe. At most 8 subscriptions and 12 source events. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.

explanation: Replay the source independently for each subscriber, tracking its next-count and terminal state. O(subscriptions times source events) time and output space; this is a synchronous transcript adapter. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
